expectations.text: States AIC targets out-of-sample predictive accuracy (expected KL / deviance); efficient, does not assume a true model in the set.
expectations.evidence: States AIC estimates out-of-sample predictive deviance (expected KL); efficient but not consistent; does not assume true model in candidate set.

expectations.text: States BIC targets the true/parsimonious model (marginal-likelihood / consistency) under the assumption the true model is among the candidates.
expectations.evidence: States BIC ≈ log marginal likelihood via Laplace; consistent if true model is in candidate set — explicitly owns that assumption.

expectations.text: Frames the choice by the question being asked (prediction vs identifying the true model) rather than declaring one universally superior or averaging them.
expectations.evidence: Reframes as category error; provides decision rule by question; explicitly prohibits averaging.

expectations.text: Recommends cross-validation / LOO (or notes AIC ≈ LOO) as a direct way to settle a prediction-focused decision.
expectations.evidence: Recommends LOO-CV as a direct arbiter; notes AIC ≈ LOO asymptotically.
